description: This file contains unit tests for the Vector module, testing vector operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, magnitude, distance, equality, copying, and swizzling.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: Assumed class representing 2D/3D vectors with associated operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two vectors, either via operator or Vector.add method.

methods.name: mult
methods.description: Multiplies two vectors, either via operator or Vector.mult method.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtracts two vectors, either via operator or Vector.sub method.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Divides two vectors, either via operator or Vector.div method.

methods.name: idiv
methods.description: Integer division of vectors, either via operator or Vector.idiv method.

methods.name: magSq
methods.description: Calculates the squared magnitude of a vector

methods.name: mag
methods.description: Calculates the magnitude of a vector

methods.name: dist
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two vectors

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the vector
